numeric_contract.dnn_scaler_fit: StandardScaler on corresponding training features only; retain mean/scale float64
numeric_contract.dnn_scaler_export: mean and scale float32; subtract then divide explicitly float32 everywhere
numeric_contract.standard_scaler_zero_variance: scale 1 according to fitted StandardScaler; no ad hoc repairs
numeric_contract.quantization: affine float32 z/scale+zero_point, nearest_even rint, clip int8
numeric_contract.nonfinite_policy: stop and preserve failure, no silent repair

dnn.training_loss: mean class-balanced weighted sparse crossentropy plus L2
dnn.validation_loss: unweighted mean sparse crossentropy plus L2
dnn.outer_epochs: integer median of nine best inner epochs for that mask; no outer early stopping

quantization.representative_rows: all corresponding training windows in ascending global_window_id

detector.primary_mode: shared representation S except feature indices 4 and 11
detector.centroid: mean(Z_float32, dtype=float64) then cast float32; do not force zero
detector.score: ordered float32 subtract/divide/square/sequential sum, no FMA
detector.threshold: minimum observed float32 score with equal-record empirical CDF >= 19/20, no interpolation
detector.threshold_record_weights: each calibration MAT equal total mass; each window mass 1/(R*n_record)
detector.rejection: score strictly greater than threshold; ties accepted
detector.cache_key: feature indices, exact authorized fit/calibration IDs, numeric contract, input/config/version hashes

selection.aggregation: arithmetic mean of nine inner macro-F1 scores, equal three loads and three seeds; not pooled probabilities
selection.detector_metrics: normal specificity, IR recall and OR recall averaged by MAT then equally by validation load
selection.detector_reference: new F14 detector with this same fit/calibration policy, not V1 test metrics
selection.performance_selector: detector-admissible masks; highest mean F1, then highest worst-load mean across seeds, then catalogue order
selection.numeric_tie_rule: within 1e-12 of stage maximum; mean, then worst-load mean, then catalogue; not a predictive margin
selection.cost_selector: same candidate fits and detector constraints; F1 within margin; choose measured total cost using empirical envelope rule
selection.cost_tie_rule: min upper_ms; overlapping candidates with lower_ms<=minimum_upper form tie set; prefer F1, worst-load F1, catalogue order
selection.fallback: F14 and record target not achieved if no eligible target-reaching candidate
selection.cost_reduction_vs_performance_selector: report measured difference; no guaranteed improvement
selection.missing_or_failed_inner_fit: stop; never omit from the mean

total_cost_calibration.formula: T_features(union) + T_DNN_scaling_quantization + T_INT8_DNN + T_normality_score + measured integration residual
total_cost_calibration.primary_method: direct full-pipeline measurements of predefined inner representatives, not an unvalidated proxy
total_cost_calibration.representatives: each outer: inner_validation_load=min(development_loads), seed=11, all eight masks
total_cost_calibration.benchmark_loads: exact two training loads of the predefined representative
total_cost_calibration.benchmark_rows: first and last window of each of the fourteen training MAT: 28 windows, same rows for all eight masks
total_cost_calibration.cost_table: per outer and mask: mean_ms, lower_ms=min observed total, upper_ms=max observed total

classical_comparators.selection: mean inner macro-F1; worst-load mean then grid order; outer refit after selection

runtime_pilot.purpose: timing and technical conversion only; not representation or margin selection
